Criterion: Verify that the weight of each passenger exit, if removable, and its means of opening, is conspicuously marked. Standard (Air Force): The means of opening and weight of each removable passenger exit hatch or door is clearly marked on the hatch or door. Method of Compliance (Air Force): Inspection and engineering drawing documentation verify that each hatch door is clearly marked with its means of opening and weight. References: JSSG-2010-13: 3.13.5 14 CFR 25.811

Standard: The means of opening and weight of each removable emergency hatch or door is clearly marked on the hatch or door. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of engineering drawings or models verifies that each removable emergency hatch or door is clearly marked with its means of opening and weight.
